senses.gloss: m., pl. טַצְדְּקֵי (= אִצְטַ׳; צדק, v. Pesik. Zutr. to Gen. XLIV, 16) excuse, subterfuge.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 41a:16">Men. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ למיפטר וכ׳</he> you want excuses to free yourself from the duty of wearing show-fringes. [For the phonetic inflection of our and the following wds., cmp. Nöld. Mand. Gramm. § 49.]
